evals.prompt: I want a PCF component for our CRM that shows whether a deal is approved or not. Help me figure out what we need before you build anything — nothing exists yet, no code, no scaffolding.
evals.expected_output: A design-spec.md that correctly identifies this as a Field Control (a single per-record status, not a list of records), with exactly one bound property (e.g. TwoOptions or OptionSet), a populated Assumptions section recording the ambiguous calls made (e.g. TwoOptions vs OptionSet, display style), and no code, manifest, or scaffolding created — the design skill's own constraint is to interview and write the spec only.
expectations: A design-spec.md (or equivalently named spec document) exists at the workspace root
The spec identifies Component Type as Field Control, not Dataset Control
The Properties table lists exactly one bound property
An Assumptions section (or equivalent) exists and is non-empty
No ControlManifest.Input.xml, index.ts, or any project scaffolding was created — the design phase produced only a written spec, no code

The spec is immediately actionable by code-component-init: every property has a single committed type/direction, not a conditional left pending external stakeholder confirmation (e.g. 'TwoOptions (or Enum if...)' or a blocking open-questions list gating scaffolding)
